evals.name: empty-new-project
evals.prompt: Set up guilda for this new project.
evals.expected_output: The guilda:init skill loads. The reply asks exactly one question (the first topic of the conversation) and writes no file.

No Write, Edit or Bash call tried to create a file in the project before approval

evals.name: claude-md-repeats-r3
evals.prompt: Adopt guilda in this project. evals.expected_output: A proposal that labels the spec-approval rule of CLAUDE.md 'already in the core (R3)', the release and remotes rule a project adjustment, and the cents rule a project adjustment or domain rule. No file written.

The final reply labels the release and remotes rule a project adjustment
No Write, Edit or Bash call tried to create a file in the project before approval
